text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I was having a meeting 
with Epiphaneia—
choice_data_list:
This time, we'll focus on improving 
stamina—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list:
? So I was going to try out the new 
equipment too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she's exhausted; despite her 
energetic replies, it feels like nothing 
is getting through to her. I should 
probably reconsider our upcoming schedule.
